# POUR / PLAY: credits

The page now uses AI-generated product films (Higgsfield: GPT Image stills animated with Kling 3.0) for GRIND, POUR and SIP. The coffee brand is fictional.

The earlier 3D version used five poly.pizza models (Coffee bean, Espresso cup, French press by Poly by Google, CC-BY 3.0; Cafetiere by Ian MacGillivray, CC-BY 3.0; Coffee Filter by reyshapes, CC0). Their files remain in `assets/*.glb` but are no longer loaded.
